title: Database Access and Availability Check
outcome: I understand your frustration; it feels counter-intuitive when you have a reliable database available right there on your local machine. The limitation isn't a failure of the database, but rather a feature of my operating environment. I run in a highly secured, sandboxed cloud environment for stability and security. This sandbox is deliberately isolated from private local area networks (like your `192.168.1.x` network) for security reasons. I can only access resources that are publicly exposed via the internet or resources explicitly made available within my execution context. However, there are several standard workarounds to bridge this gap and allow my agent to access your Datasette database: ### 1. The Tunneling Approach (Best for live access) This is the most robust solution if you need real-time, interactive access. * **How it works:** Tools like **ngrok** or **Cloudflare Tunnel**…
